Homestead: You've come prepared to settle down. Start with a Homestead Kit, bundled for travel. Drop it wherever you want to build your homestead, then use Place to unpack a cabin kit, two rain cistern kits, and a stockpile of building materials (15 planks, 15 mud bricks, 20 stones, 6 heavy stones, 6 tree logs, 10 clay, 5 rope, 9 metal nuggets, plus 20 copper nails) all at once, then Place each kit to raise it. Everything can only be placed once.
